notes.title: Incandescent 2 Update
notes.content:
Global Leaderboards are here! 

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*]Global Leaderboards have been added.
[*]Single player mode has been refined and has better pacing.
[*]Single player is now wave based instead of complicated round and wave setup.
[*]Background grid has been removed to make it easier to see the enemies.
[*]Increased stat tracking. Now tracks individual kill types.
[*]General performance improvements.
[/list]
